# Rust line-coverage baseline, in percent, for the rust-coverage ratchet in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml. The first non-comment line is the number.
#
# How the ratchet works:
# - The job measures line coverage of src-tauri with cargo-llvm-cov.
# - If coverage drops more than 0.1 points below this number the ratchet step
#   fails, and with it the rust-coverage job and ci-ok. It is a hard gate.
# - When the job reports that coverage is at least 1 point above this number,
#   raise the number in the same change. Never lower it without a written
#   reason in the commit message, and never exclude code to meet it.
#
# Set on 2026-10-10 from CI run 38020543419 at 87d49f9: 84.17% of lines
# (120,695 of 143,390), less half a point for run-to-run noise.
# The frontend has its own thresholds, in vitest.config.ts.
83.67
